prompt: cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look, wide establishing composition. A towering, monolithic stack of weathered steel shipping containers looms asymmetrically on the left, dwarfing a narrow, shadowed rail transfer seam in the center. Crisp atmospheric depth, low-angle perspective, restrained teal-and-amber palette. A single strong practical worklight cuts across the steel siding, highlighting the lack of buffer space. No people facing camera, motion implied rather than shown. High-end editorial standard, dramatic scale and tension.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, garbled text
rationale: The article explicitly points out the massive scale of the bottleneck at port terminals where ground buffer space is exhausted. A cinematic still captures this physical reality with dramatic lighting and monumental scale, illustrating the tension at the handoff point.
